findings.title: Cross-feature import of DisconnectBanner from features/board/
findings.detail: HistoryPage imports DisconnectBanner from '../../board/DisconnectBanner'. DisconnectBanner lives in features/board/ and is now consumed by two features (app/AppLayout for dispatcher + this driver feature). web-architecture forbids driver -> board imports; code needed by 2+ features should be promoted to src/shared/. Functionally correct (the established last-known-state pattern), so non-blocking.
findings.recommendation: Promote DisconnectBanner to src/shared/realtime/ (or src/shared/ui) and update both AppLayout and HistoryPage imports. Out of B3e's file scope to move board's file; track as follow-up. Until then it is an observed architecture drift, not a functional defect.

findings.title: Persistent BottomNav + Content overflow:auto apply to /d/ride and /d/ride/complete
findings.detail: B3e adds a non-fixed flex BottomNav and wraps the Outlet in Content(flex:1, overflow:auto) inside Shell(min-height:100dvh). History/Settings pages use min-height:100% (fit Content) and render correctly. Ride/complete pages use min-height:100dvh on their own root (built to own the viewport before the nav existed), so inside Content they make the Shell grow taller than the viewport: the page scrolls and the nav sits just below the fold. Verified the two session-wide components above Content (DriverPositionReporter -> StalePositionBanner, DriverQueueBar) both render null in the normal idle ride state, so the ride's own primary big button stays within the 100dvh viewport; the nav is reachable by scroll. Cosmetic, not an off-screen primary action. A stale-position or queue banner (abnormal states) adds ~40px, pushing the nav further below fold but still not hiding the ride button.
findings.recommendation: Consider suppressing BottomNav on 'ride' and 'ride/complete' routes (a DriverLayout-scoped change) so those full-screen flows keep a clean 100dvh without a scroll tail. Low priority; current behavior is usable and all 627 tests pass.

findings.title: radiogroup/radio on buttons without roving tabindex or arrow-key navigation
findings.detail: NavAppPreference uses role=radiogroup with role=radio buttons and aria-checked. Each option is a real <button>, so each is Tab/Enter/Space reachable and axe does not flag it. A strict ARIA radiogroup would use roving tabindex + arrow keys, but the native button fallback is fully operable. No action required.
findings.recommendation: Optional: keep as-is (operable) or switch to native radio inputs if strict radiogroup semantics are desired later.

summary: laneB3e (B-history-settings) passes review. All four acceptance criteria met. (1) History /d/history is read-only: today default via todayPragueIso, previous days selectable with max=today, renders from GET /drivers/me/orders through useMyOrders (TanStack Query, hierarchical key ['driver','orders',date], unwraps {orders} envelope via select). historyTotals.computeHistoryTotals counts and sums ONLY status==='Completed' rides, skips active rides (continue), defaults null finalPriceCzk via ?? 0 (no NaN), empty day -> all-zero totals. Money is integer CZK formatted at render via Intl.NumberFormat('cs-CZ') + ' Kč'; no float math. Offline uses the SignalR-keyed DisconnectBanner (last-known + banner), not navigator.onLine. (2) Settings /d/settings REUSE the existing driverSettings.ts keys: useDriverSettings is a thin useState+write-through over getSilentMode/setSilentMode and getNavAppPreference/setNavAppPreference with NO new localStorage keys, so B-offer sound (getSilentMode) and B-ride nav (getNavAppPreference) stay in sync. Logout clears authStorage + idbAuthStore + transitionQueue + idbRideStore and routes /d/login while intentionally keeping preference keys. Diagnostika feature-detects Notification and navigator.permissions (jsdom-safe, unknown fallback) and shows location/push permission, last position sent (from B-position useOwnPositionStore), and SignalR state. (3) No server state mirrored into Zustand/module globals; useMyOrders is the single TanStack cache. (4) Routes added only under /d; /x untouched; bottom nav landmark has aria-label via driver.nav.label. (5) i18n cs/en parity green (0 mismatches; all connection/permission/payment/unknown/never/active keys present in both); axe assertions present in all five new component test files; touch targets >=48px (options, toggle row) and logout >=64px primary. Three non-blocking findings: one cross-feature import (DisconnectBanner, should be promoted to shared), one cosmetic nav-layout note on ride/complete (nav reachable by scroll, primary button not hidden in normal state), one informational a11y note on radiogroup keyboard semantics. blocks_merge = false.
